messages:
maria: Quick Q — product analytics wants to share a ~50k-row log sample with an external vendor for model tuning. Fields: user_id (UUID), session_id, event_name, event_props (free text). Vendor has NDA but no legal/security review yet. Is this allowed?

ajay: Short answer: it depends. UUIDs are persistent identifiers and can be PII if linkable. We need pseudonymization + remove direct identifiers (email/phone/IP) from event_props. Also minimize rows to what's necessary.

sec-bot: Policy note: identifiers that can be linked to a person must be pseudonymized before external sharing. Hashed IDs are acceptable under NDA provided the key/salt is not shared and a security/privacy review is performed. See internal data-sharing guideline: https://redwood.internal/policy/data-sharing

sophie: They need session-level context to reproduce flows. If we replace `user_id` with `user_pseudonym` using HMAC (team key), will that break their analysis?

ajay: HMAC (sha256) is fine as long as the key never leaves us. Consider per-customer salt if cross-customer analysis isn't needed. Also redact PII in free text (names/emails/phones).

leo: I can spin up a quick scrub script. Example regexes: ```/(?:[a-z0-9._%+-]+@[a-z0-9.-]+\.[a-z]{2,})/i``` for emails and ```/\b\d{1,3}(?:\.\d{1,3}){3}\b/``` for IPv4. We should also trim long free-text fields to X chars and remove quoted sections.

maria: Awesome. One more: do we need a security ticket + legal signoff before sharing the 50k rows, or is NDA alone enough?

sec-bot: Process: if dataset contains identifiers or free text, you must open an INFRA-SEC ticket and attach a sanitized sample and schema. Security + privacy will review; legal reviews the contract terms for re-identification and retention. Typical turnaround ~48h.

sophie: :+1: I'll open the ticket. @maria can you paste exact column list + one sanitized sample row into a Google doc and link it?

maria: Will do. Plan: replace `user_id` with HMAC_SHA256(user_id, team_salt), scrub emails/IPs from event_props, truncate event_props to 500 chars, and redaction log the changes.

ajay: Also add vendor retention & deletion schedule to the contract and a no-reidentification clause. If vendor requests re-identification, route to legal immediately.

legal-bot: Heads up — our standard template includes a no-reid clause but ask vendor to sign the vendor DPA addendum if they will see pseudonymized identifiers.

maria: Thanks everyone — I'll sanitize a sample and file INFRA-SEC now. Marking resolved for the thread. :white_check_mark:
